title: The information needed for a fresh count and its timing
claim: First characterize the least external information that gives the fresh count, then settle the seven-knot births under admissible serial orders and under the fixed-map reading, with both actual laws, rulers and a named sample.
standard_statement: For a hypergraph replacement operator, compute the minimum conditional message describing the future degree of a marked hyperedge from its parent incidence. Compare all admissible asynchronous transition orders to linear extensions of a fixed locally finite partially ordered set.
prior_work: The previous operator supplies the successor group count and arity floor; the identified class has the known witness size formula. The 7-knot example and previously refereed serial laws do not determine its conditional range or all-order behavior.
source_contribution: A conditional information lower bound and the complete order quantifiers on a physically linked counterexample.
remaining_obligations: Give a sufficient computable external statistic and compare sharp cases, then characterize literal schedules and the fixed-map event order.
